scope: All hbar-independent polynomial partners of nonzero homogeneous binary quartics over characteristic zero; canonical constant-coefficient Weyl–Moyal convention; no novelty claim.

results.title: Complete graded rank classification
results.statement: If H=aR^g, R primitive of degree e=4/g in {1,2,4}, then dim E_n(H)=2+1_{e divides n−2} for n>=2; dimE0=1,dimE1=2.
results.proof: Apolar adjoint to the Poisson centralizer two degrees lower.

results.title: Canonical active quartic partner
results.statement: Hessian Δ=HqqHpp−Hqp² satisfies T3(H,Δ)=0. If H is not a quadratic square, E4=span(H,Δ), and {H,Δ} is nonzero.

results.title: Power obstruction
results.statement: T3(H,H^r)=−r(r−1)(4r+1)/3 H^(r−2){H,Δ}. For primitive H, E∩K[H]=span(1,H).

results.title: Exhaustive constructive recurrence
results.statement: The explicit banded transvectant matrix computes all E_n, with three seed coefficients and one terminal compatibility condition in a coordinate chart with q4 coefficient nonzero.

results.title: Closure and evolution failure
results.statement: For H=q4+p4,G=q²p², the first bracket is exact but the second acquires +960 hbar²q²p². E(H) is generally not a product algebra or ad_H invariant.

open_scope: Invariant subspaces supporting exact repeated Hamiltonian dynamics
Closed-form bases for arbitrary quartic coefficients beyond the exhaustive recurrence

references.label: Olver–Sanders, Transvectants, Modular Forms, and the Heisenberg Algebra (classical framework; precise claims above proved directly)
